_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro: {num_players}-Jokalariaren ingurua {width}x{height} sareko. Zu zara {player_id} jokalari. Mugimendu baliagarriak: "[up]" "[down]" "[left]" "[right]" edo w/s/a/d. Helburua: beste guztiak baino gehiago bizi. Bideak hilgarriak dira; horma jotzeak hil egiten du; aurrez aurreko talkak biak hil egiten ditu.

game_action.invalid_death: Jokalari {player_id} mugimendu ezegokia dela eta hil zen.

outcome.survived_win: Jokalariak {player_id} bizirik atera zen; beste guztiek istripu bat izan zuten.
outcome.all_crashed: Jokalari guztiak une berean hil dira.
outcome.outlived: Besteak baino gehiago bizi izan zen.
outcome.turn_limit: Turn limit reached - longest survivor wins.
